163	    if (c.sl[i]! !== st.slope[i]!) { r.dSl++; mark(i); const k = `S${c.sl[i]}>${st.slope[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`S(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.sl[i]} j${st.slope[i]}`); }

154	/** Check3x2（cs:49190-49868）：样式族门 → destroyObject 击杀链 → 5×5 扫 */
155	function __pileCheck3x2(st: TileStore, cx: number, cy: number, sheet: number): void {
156	  if (__destroyObj) return;                                             // cs:49193 早退
157	  const i = st.idx(cx, cy);
158	  const style = Math.floor(st.frameX[i]! / 54);                         // cs:49208-49215 num6
159	  const y0 = cy - ((st.frameY[i]! % 36) / 18 | 0);                      // num（布局恒新写对齐）
160	  let bad = false;
161	  for (let c = cx - 1; c <= cx + 1; c++) {
162	    if (!solidTileAllowBottomSlope(st, c, y0 + 2) || invalidPiles(st, c, y0 + 2)) { bad = true; continue; }
163	    const b = sheetAt(st, c, y0 + 2);
164	    if (b < 0) continue;
165	    if (sheet === 186) {
166	      if (style >= 26 && style <= 31 && !SET_SNOW.has(b) && !SET_ICE.has(b) && b !== 162 && b !== 224) bad = true;
167	      else if (style >= 32 && style <= 34 && !SET_MUD.has(b) && b !== 70) bad = true;
168	    } else if (sheet === 187) {
169	      if (style <= 5 && !SET_MUD.has(b) && b !== 60 && b !== 226) bad = true;
170	      else if (style >= 6 && style <= 8 && b !== 57 && b !== 58 && b !== 75 && b !== 76) bad = true;
171	      else if (style >= 29 && style <= 34
172	        && !SET_SAND.has(b) && !SET_HARDENED_SAND.has(b) && !SET_SANDSTONE.has(b)) bad = true;
173	    }
174	  }
175	  if (!bad) return;
176	  __destroyObj = true;                                                  // cs:49421
177	  for (let c = cx - 1; c <= cx + 1; c++) {
178	    for (let r = y0; r <= y0 + 1; r++) {
179	      const k = st.idx(c, r);
180	      if (st.flags[k] && SHEET[st.type[k]] === sheet) {
181	        // KillTile（cs:63933-63967）：失活+清半砖/帧/油漆/**type=0**（cs:63965）+
182	        // 尾 SquareTileFrame = 3×3 非活跃格清 half/slope/paint（活格 186/187 邻的
183	        // Check3x2 因 destroyObj 早退=无连杀）
184	        st.flags[k] = 0; st.half[k] = 0; st.slope[k] = 0;
185	        st.frameX[k] = 0; st.frameY[k] = 0; st.paint[k] = 0; st.type[k] = 0;
186	        for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
187	          for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
188	            const nxc = c + dx, nyc = r + dy;
189	            if (nxc <= 5 || nyc <= 5 || nxc >= st.w - 5 || nyc >= st.h - 5) continue;
190	            const ni = st.idx(nxc, nyc);
191	            if (!st.flags[ni]) { st.half[ni] = 0; st.slope[ni] = 0; st.paint[ni] = 0; }
192	          }
193	        }
194	      }
195	    }
196	  }
197	  __destroyObj = false;                                                 // cs:49856
198	  for (let c = cx - 2; c <= cx + 2; c++) {
199	    for (let r = y0 - 1; r <= y0 + 3; r++) __pileFrameCell(st, c, r);   // cs:49857-49862 5×5 扫
200	  }
201	}

203	function placePile3x2(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, type: number, style: number): boolean {
204	  (globalThis as { __swPilesCap?: (x: number, y: number, t: number, s: number, z: number, k: number) => void }).__swPilesCap?.(x, y, SHEET[type] ?? -1, style, 0, 0);
205	  // PlaceTile 前置清（cs:59497-59500：目标 inactive → Clear(Tile|Paint|Slope)——type/帧
206	  // 归零、半砖/坡/油漆清）——在 case 门**之前**，放置失败也清（锚格残值 type 被抹，
207	  // 上游 rawSheetAt 命中判定随之失败 → 该 attempt 不算命中）。★OOOO 实证：首差
208	  // eff (3007,646) i0 vs i1 = 此清缺失
209	  if (st.inBounds(x, y)) {
210	    const ti = st.idx(x, y);
211	    if (!st.flags[ti]) {
212	      st.type[ti] = 0; st.frameX[ti] = 0; st.frameY[ti] = 0;
213	      st.half[ti] = 0; st.slope[ti] = 0; st.paint[ti] = 0;
214	    }
215	  }
216	  if (x < 5 || x > st.w - 5 || y < 5 || y > st.h - 5) return false;   // cs:52102 边距门
217	  // ★OOOO：vanilla 的 type 比较全在 sheet 空间（186/187），本函数形参 type 是内部 id
218	  //  （PILE186=150/PILE187=145）——曾直接 `type === 186/187` 恒假，InvalidTile 门与
219	  //  Check3x2 样式族击杀链整段死代码（#77 残 1227/1270 主根因；首例 = 沙漠化石 404
220	  //  地基 187-style32，vanilla Check3x2 沙族不含 404 → 击杀，JS 保留）
221	  const sheet = SHEET[type] ?? -1;
222	  const isPile = sheet === 186 || sheet === 187;
223	  let ok = true;
224	  for (let c = x - 1; c <= x + 1; c++) {
225	    for (let r = y - 1; r <= y; r++) {
226	      const i = st.idx(c, r);
227	      if (st.flags[i]) ok = false;                                     // 占用净空（cs:52117）
228	    }
229	    if (isPile && invalidPiles(st, c, y + 1)) ok = false;              // cs:52141+52149
230	    if (!solidTile2(st, c, y + 1)) ok = false;                         // cs:52156
231	  }
232	  if (!ok) return false;
233	  const base = style * 54;
234	  for (let c = x - 1; c <= x + 1; c++) {
235	    for (let r = y - 1; r <= y; r++) {
236	      const i = st.idx(c, r);
237	      st.type[i] = type; st.flags[i] = 1;
238	      st.frameX[i] = base + (c - (x - 1)) * 18;
239	      st.frameY[i] = r === y - 1 ? 0 : 18;
240	      // 原版 Place3x2 只写 active/frameX/frameY/type（cs:52200-52234）——不清坡/半砖/液体
241	    }
242	  }
243	  // 尾随 SquareTileFrame(i,j)（cs:60026+cs:60281 两次，效果合并）：中心 → Check3x2
244	  __pileCheck3x2(st, x, y, sheet);
245	  // 3×3 非活跃格清（两帧调用的 TileFrame 头并集；活格侧 Check3x2 已覆盖）
246	  for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
247	    for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
248	      const nxc = x + dx, nyc = y + dy;
249	      if (nxc <= 5 || nyc <= 5 || nxc >= st.w - 5 || nyc >= st.h - 5) continue;
250	      const ni = st.idx(nxc, nyc);
251	      if (!st.flags[ni]) { st.half[ni] = 0; st.slope[ni] = 0; st.paint[ni] = 0; }
252	    }
253	  }
254	  return true;
255	}

    var psm = wg.Methods.First(m => m.Name == "PlaceSmallPile" && m.Parameters.Count == 5);

    var il2 = psm.Body.GetILProcessor();
    il2.InsertBefore(psm.Body.Instructions[0], il2.Create(OpCodes.Call, psRef));
    for (int pi = 4; pi >= 0; pi--) il2.InsertBefore(psm.Body.Instructions[0], il2.Create(OpCodes.Ldarg, psm.Parameters[pi]));
    Console.WriteLine("hooked PlaceSmallPile");
    var urType = mod.Types.First(t => t.FullName == "Terraria.Utilities.UnifiedRandom");
    var naRef = mod.ImportReference(probeType.Methods.First(x => x.Name == "NA"));

// OOOO 批 #77：Piles 逐掷 genRand 状态哈希（Next(int)/Next(int,int) 头）。
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;

namespace Terraria.WorldBuilding
{
    public static class SlopeProbe
    {
        public static bool _on;
        static StreamWriter _w;
        static FieldInfo _sa, _ix;
        static string P() { var p = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SW_SLOPEP"); return string.IsNullOrEmpty(p) ? "/tmp/oooo-slope.txt" : p; }
        public static void RP(string passName)
        {
            if (passName == "Piles")
            {
                _on = true;
                _w = new StreamWriter(P(), false);
                _w.WriteLine("START");
            }
            else if (_on)
            {
                _on = false;
                if (_w != null) { _w.WriteLine("END"); _w.Flush(); _w.Close(); _w = null; }
            }
        }
        static void H(char tag)
        {
            if (!_on) return;
            var r = Terraria.WorldGen.genRand;
            if (_sa == null)
            {
                var t = r.GetType();
                _sa = t.GetField("SeedArray", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
                _ix = t.GetField("inext", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
            }
            var sa = (int[])_sa.GetValue(r);
            uint ix = (uint)_ix.GetValue(r);
            uint h = 2166136261u;
            for (int k = 0; k < sa.Length; k++)
            {
                int v = sa[k];
                h = (h ^ (uint)(v & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
            }
            h = (h ^ (ix & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
            h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
            h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
            h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
            _w.WriteLine(tag == 'a' ? "a " + h.ToString("x8") : "b " + h.ToString("x8"));
        }
        public static void NA() { H('a'); }   // Next(int) 头
        public static void NB() { H('b'); }   // Next(int,int) 头
        public static void KT(int i, int j)
        {
            if (!_on) return;
            var t = Terraria.Main.tile[i, j];
            _w.WriteLine($"kill {i} {j} {(t.active() ? t.type.ToString() : "-")}");
        }
        public static void PL(int x, int y, int type, int style)
        {
            if (!_on) return;
            _w.WriteLine($"P3 {x} {y} {type} {style}");
        }
        public static void PS(int i, int j, int pileStyle, int pileSize, int type)
        {
            if (!_on) return;
            _w.WriteLine($"PS {i} {j} {type} {pileStyle}");
        }
    }
}

342:function updateStalagtiteStyle(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, j: number): boolean {
364:function killStalactiteTile(
381:function solidTileSlope(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
function killStalactiteTile(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number,
  reframe?: (st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number) => void,
): void {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i]) return;
  st.flags[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 0;
  st.frameX[i] = 65535; st.frameY[i] = 65535;  // -1（Uint16 环回；inactive 格不读帧）
  st.type[i] = 0;
  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
    if (reframe) reframe(st, rng, x + dx, y + dy);
    else frame165(st, rng, x + dx, y + dy);
  }
}
function updateStalagtiteStyle(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, j: number): boolean {
  const i0 = st.idx(x, j);
  const style = STYLE_BY_FX54.get(Math.trunc(st.frameX[i0]! / 54));
  if (style === undefined) return false;
  const d = getDesiredStalagtiteStyle(st, x, j);
  if (d.fail) return false;
  if (style !== d.style) {
    const fx = rng.int(0, 2) * 18 + FX_BASE_BY_STYLE[d.style]!;
    for (let k = d.y; k < d.y + d.height; k++) {
      if (st.inBounds(x, k)) st.frameX[st.idx(x, k)] = fx;
    }
  }
  return true;
}
function solidTileSlope(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  return st.flags[i] !== 0 && genSolidType(st.type[i]) && st.half[i] === 0 && st.slope[i] === 0;
}

new Uint8Array(st.w * st.h);   // 缺省=全未覆盖（纯几何模式）\n  const sheetOf = (x: number, y: number): number => {\n    if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return -1;\n    const i = st.idx(x, y);\n    return st.flags[i] ? SHEET[st.type[i]] : -1;\n  };\n  const solidish = (x: number, y: number): boolean => {\n    if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;\n    const i = st.idx(x, y);\n    return st.flags[i] !== 0 && !!TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.solid;\n  };\n  const supSheet = (x: number, y: number): number => {\n    if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return -1;\n    const i = st.idx(x, y);\n    return st.flags[i] ? SHEET[st.type[i]] : -1;\n  };\n  for (let y = 0; y < st.h; y++) {\n    for (let x = 0; x < st.w; x++) {\n      const i = st.idx(x, y);\n      if (!st.flags[i]) continue;\n      const sh = SHEET[st.type[i]];\n      if (sh < 0) continue;\n      if (SMALLPILE.has(sh)) {\n        if (!isCov[i]) { st.frameX[i] = 0; st.frameY[i] = 0; }\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (STALACTITE.has(sh)) {\n        if (isCov[i]) continue;\n        const up = sheetOf(x, y - 1) === sh;\n        let fy: number, supY: number, hang2 = false;\n        if (!up) {\n          fy = solidish(x, y - 1) ? 72 : 90;\n          supY = fy === 72 ? y - 1 : y + 1;\n        } else {\n          const hang = solidish(x, y - 2);\n          fy = hang ? 18 : 54;\n          hang2 = hang;\n          supY = hang ? y - 2 : y + 1;\n        }\n        const style = styleForSup(supSheet(x, supY), st.wall[i]!, hang2);\n        const fx = style >= 0 ? FX_BASE_BY_STYLE[style]! : 0;\n        st.frameY[i] = fy;\n        st.frameX[i] = fx;\n        if (up) {\n          const ti = st.idx(x, y - 1);\n          if (!isCov[ti]) { st.frameY[ti] = hang2 ? 0 : 36; st.frameX[ti] = fx; }\n        }\n        continue;\n      }\n      let w = 2, h = 2;\n      if (BOX2.has(sh)) { w = 2; h = 2; }\n      else if (BOX3X2.has(sh)) { w = 3; h = 2; }\n      else if (BOX3W.has(sh)) { w = 3; h = 3; }\n      else if (DOOR.has(sh)) { w = 1; h = 3; }\n      else continue;\n      if (isCov[i]) continue;                       // 覆盖格保留边界帧\n      // 横向 run：相位优先取覆盖格的 frameX，否则右锚\n      let runX = x;\n      while (sheetOf(runX + 1, y) === sh) runX++;\n      let phaseX: number | null = null;\n      let styleX = 0;\n      for (let cx = runX; cx >= runX - (runX - x) - w && cx >= x - w * 40; cx--) {\n        if (cx < 0) break;\n        const ci = st.idx(cx, y);\n        if (sheetOf(cx, y) === sh && isCov[ci]) {\n          const fx = st.frameX[ci]!;\n          const col = Math.floor(fx / 18) % w;\n          phaseX = ((cx - col) % w + w) % w;        // run 内 x≡phaseX 的列为盒左列\n          styleX = Math.floor(fx / (18 * w));\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n      let x0: number;\n      if (phaseX !== null) {\n        x0 = x - (((x - phaseX) % w) + w) % w;\n      } else {\n        x0 = runX - Math.floor((runX - x) / w) * w - w + 1;\n        styleX = sh === 186 || sh === 187 ? 9 : 0;  // 无门带 + <864 免金币掷\n      }\n      // 纵向 run：右锚（竖排族罕见邻接）\n      let runY = y;\n      while (sheetOf(x, runY + 1) === sh) runY++;\n      const y0 = runY - Math.floor((runY - y) / h) * h - h + 1;\n      st.frameX[i] = (x - x0) * 18 + styleX * w * 18;\n      st.frameY[i] = (y - y0) * 18;\n    }\n  }\n}\n"
}

/** GenState 深克隆（typed array → 普通 array，JSON 可序列化） */
function serGs(gs: unknown): unknown {
  if (gs === null || typeof gs !== 'object') return gs;
  if (gs instanceof Int32Array || gs instanceof Uint8Array || gs instanceof Float32Array) return Array.from(gs);
  if (Array.isArray(gs)) return gs.map(serGs);
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
